title: Pulse Vision Frames Plus
alludes_to: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses (Gen 1) — camera glasses
description: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses (Gen 1) — camera glasses is the nominative anchor for this record. The Pulse Vision Frames Plus carries the same working details — 12 MP camera with open-ear audio, from $299 — rendered as a fully original Signature work. It reached the market in 2023, aimed at everyday wearers.
